entries.german:
Albrecht von Rosenberg zu Boxberg, Ritter, verkauft auf ewige Zeiten dem Wolf von Hardheim und dessen Erben alle Rechte und Gerechtigkeiten an seinem Viertel des Dorfs Bretzingen um 1.500 Gulden.

Laufzeit: 1555 Juli 4 (Donnerstag nach Peter und Paul 1535)
entries.english:
Albrecht of Rosenberg at Boxberg, Knight, sells in perpetuity to Wolf of Hardheim and his heirs all rights and privileges in his quarter of the village of Bretzingen for 1,500 guilders.

Duration: July 4, 1555 (Thursday after Saints Peter and Paul, 1535)

facts.content: sold his rights in a quarter of Bretzingen to Wolf von Hardheim and his heirs.
